# Structured data generated by the site

`scripts/build.py` inserts JSON-LD using `https://schema.org` into the homepage
and every crawlable detail page. The structured data is generated from the same
content that is visibly rendered; do not add hidden information solely for
search engines.

## Homepage

The homepage contains a graph with:

- `WebSite`
- `WebPage`
- `RadioSeries`

The programme name, description, Radio Blau affiliation, public profiles and
team are taken from `content/site.json`.

## Upcoming radio broadcasts

Entries in `content/upcoming-broadcasts.json` produce `RadioEpisode` with a
`BroadcastEvent` and `RadioBroadcastService`.

```json
{
  "date": "2026-08-29T21:00:00",
  "episode_number": 100,
  "title_de": "sofea #100 – tba",
  "title_en": "sofea #100 – tba",
  "details_de": "Drei Stunden elektronische Musik. Live auf Radio Blau.",
  "details_en": "Three hours of electronic music. Live on Radio Blau.",
  "image": "/assets/images/uploads/sofea-100.png",
  "links": []
}
```

`episode_number` is optional. If present, it is emitted as Schema.org
`episodeNumber` and is also used in selected visible labels and social cards.
Broadcasts default to three hours and to the visible location
`Radio Blau, Leipzig`.

## Upcoming events

Entries in `content/upcoming-events.json` produce `MusicEvent`.

```json
{
  "date": "2026-09-12T20:00:00",
  "end": "2026-09-13T02:00:00",
  "title_de": "sofea night",
  "title_en": "sofea night",
  "details_de": "Eine Nacht mit dem sofea-Team und Gästen.",
  "details_en": "A night with the sofea team and guests.",
  "location": "Conne Island, Leipzig",
  "image": "/assets/images/uploads/sofea-night.png",
  "links": [
    {
      "label_de": "Veranstaltungsdetails",
      "label_en": "Event details",
      "url": "https://example.org/event",
      "primary": true
    }
  ]
}
```

The intentionally strict CMS schema uses one visible `location` field rather
than a hidden set of address and performer fields. External links are emitted
as `sameAs` values.

## Archived broadcasts

Entries from the SoundCloud cache are merged with editorial enrichment in
`content/episodes.json`. Detail pages produce `RadioEpisode`, `RadioSeries` and
`AudioObject`.

```json
{
  "date": "2026-03-14",
  "episode_number": 98,
  "title_de": "Neele",
  "title_en": "Neele",
  "audio_url": "https://soundcloud.com/sounds-of-electronic-art/neele-2026-03-14",
  "details_de": "Mitschnitt des Sets aus der 98. Sendung im März 2026.",
  "details_en": "Recording from the 98th broadcast.",
  "music_presentations": [],
  "tracklist": []
}
```

The cached SoundCloud duration is converted to an ISO-8601 duration for the
`AudioObject` when available.

## Images and social cards

Each detail page receives a generated PNG social card. A hand-designed override
may be set with `social_image`, but it must be a `.png` file:

```json
{
  "social_image": "/assets/images/uploads/special-social-card.png"
}
```

Normal detail artwork may be JPEG, PNG or WebP. The build creates responsive
WebP variants for local artwork and uses them through `srcset`.

## Validation

Run:

```cmd
py scripts\check.py
```

The validator parses every JSON-LD block, verifies the Schema.org context and
requires structured data on the homepage and all `/sendungen/` and `/termine/`
pages. Google may still decide not to show a rich result; structured data is a
machine-readable description, not a guarantee of a particular search result.
